visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Digital graphic background with golden sparkles and light rays. Title text in Chinese and English appears in the center. (2) Scene shifts to a brightly lit wedding venue. Four people are seen: a groom in a white tuxedo, a bride in a white wedding gown, a woman in a low-cut blue dress, and another man in a black suit. They are holding wine glasses and clinking them together, smiling and laughing. (3) Close-up of the woman in the blue dress. She has long brown hair and is wearing red lipstick. She looks at the bride with a subtle, mocking smile while holding her wine glass. (4) Close-up of the bride laughing heartily, holding her glass. The background is a white wall with the word 'Wedding' partially visible. (5) The woman in blue is shown in a medium shot, sipping wine while looking directly at the camera with a calculating expression. (6) The groom is seen toasting with the woman in blue. Both are smiling falsely. (7) A man identical to the groom is shown in a medium shot, holding a glass and smirking. (8) Close-up of the bride looking serious and pensive, then quickly switching back to a joyful laugh while holding her glass.
